payload.title: Purrfect Brew Beats Notebook
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Ponder!

Jot down your jazzy jots or coffee thoughts in this adorable grid notebook. Featuring a chill cat, smooth tunes, and your favorite brew, it's meow-sical inspiration for every idea!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Grid Notebook
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Pawsome Coffee Companion!

Get your paws on this adorable Kalita notebook, featuring a charming cat enjoying a brew and treats. Ideal for jotting down your most brilliant, caffeinated ideas!

payload.title: Cozy Coffee Cat Journal
payload.bodyHtml: Purr-fectly charming notebook for coffee-loving cat enthusiasts! Jot down your thoughts with your favorite feline friend and a brew by your side.

payload.title: Dobutsu Kalita Black Coffee Cat Letter Set
payload.bodyHtml: Purr-fectly brew-tiful! This mini letter set, with its charming coffee cat and cozy plaid, is ideal for sending purr-sonal notes. Espresso your feelings!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Stationery
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Brewed Correspondence!

Send a warm, fuzzy hello with this adorable Kalita mini letter set, starring a charming coffee-loving cat. Ideal for brewing up a smile!

payload.title: Kalita White Coffee Cat Stationery
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Charming!

Brew sweet notes with this adorable coffee-loving cat mini letter set. Life is coffee, write on!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Mini Letters
payload.bodyHtml: Purr-fectly brewed mini messages from your favorite coffee cup cat!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Mini Letters
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Adorable Mini Letters!

Get your daily dose of cute with these Kalita x Cat coffee cup mini letters! A cozy cat peeking from a plaid mug, ready to deliver your sweetest short-and-sweet messages. Life is coffee, and now, life is ridiculously cute stationery!

payload.title: Kalita Caramel Coffee Cat Mini Letters
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Sweet Mini Letters!

Brew up some smiles with these Kalita x Furuhashi-chan mini letters! Two adorable kitties peek from a caramel coffee cup, ready to help you send the cutest notes. Their little paws even seal your messages with a charming hug! 6 sheets of pure cuteness.

payload.title: Kalita Black Coffee Cat Mini Letters
payload.bodyHtml: Brew up some smiles with this purr-fectly adorable mini letter set! A charming cat peeks from a cozy plaid coffee cup, ready to help you send the sweetest little notes. Because Life is coffee (and incredibly cute stationery!).

payload.title: Mug O' Cat Sticky Notes
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Pawsome Coffee Break Sticky Notes!

Add a dash of feline charm to your daily grind with these adorable Kalita x Cat sticky notes! Shaped like a curious kitty peeking from a cozy coffee cup, they're purr-fect for jotting down reminders or brightening your planner.

Features:

  • Style: "Brown Coffee" chic
  • Sheets: 20 doses of pure cuteness
  • Ideal for: Coffee lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

payload.title: Caramel Coffee Cat Washi Flake Stickers
payload.bodyHtml: Paws-itively purr-fect Kalita stickers! These adorable cat & coffee flakes will perk up any surface. Life is coffee, indeed!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Flake Stickers
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Brew-tiful Sticker Fun!

Adorn your world with these paws-itively adorable Kalita x cat coffee flake stickers! Featuring cozy scenes of our feline friends enjoying their brew, these stickers are simply irresistible. Grab your pack and add a dash of charm to notebooks, planners, or anything that needs a little extra meow-gical touch!

payload.title: Kalita Coffee Cat Flake Stickers
payload.bodyHtml:
Purr-fectly Brew-tiful Kalita Cat & Coffee Flake Stickers!

Ready to perk up your day? Dive into the cozy world of Kalita with these adorable flake stickers! Featuring charming cats enjoying their 'Life is coffee' moments – from brewing a fresh pot to savoring sweet treats.

Each pack contains 20 delightful stickers (5 unique designs, 4 pieces each) to add a sprinkle of warmth and cuteness to your planners, journals, and crafts. Grab yours and make every moment a 'paws-itively' perfect coffee break!

payload.title: Kalita Caramel Coffee Cat Mini Letter Set
payload.bodyHtml: Purr-fectly brew your thoughts with this Kalita Caramel Coffee mini letter set! Adorable cats and warm coffee vibes make sending notes a cozy delight. Stickers included for extra sweetness!
